versions.changelog:
Initial release: Self-contained HTML planning skill with persistent, interactive plans.

- Generates a standalone plan.html featuring phases, drag-and-drop tickets, sliders, and embedded JSON state.
- Survives /clear events via session catchup; auto-restores context from disk.
- Tamper-protected with SHA-256 attestation; blocks plan usage if integrity check fails.
- Supports 10 templates across 9 planning categories; templates include implementation-plan, ticket-triage, and more.
- Mirrors plan.html across 17 IDE environments; allows exports back to Markdown.
- User-invocable; responds to prompts like "plan it", "make me an html plan", or when detailed, multi-phase planning is needed.
